title: bbox_bundle_evidence requires path_ids for entity-only bundles
wanted_capability: bbox_bundle_evidence should allow callers to bundle only entity_refs without requiring an explicit path_ids field when no graph paths were traversed.
fallback_used: Retried the same bbox_bundle_evidence call with path_ids: [] even though no paths were being bundled.
evidence: MCP call bbox_bundle_evidence(entity_refs=[...]) returned error.bad_input-style deserialize failure: missing field `path_ids`
Retry with path_ids: [] succeeded for an entity-only evidence bundle
notes: This is small schema friction in the agentic opening/evidence close-loop. The tool docs imply path_ids are used after bbox_find_paths, but entity-only bundles should not require a dummy empty list.
